description.summary: The caster emulates the dark energy from an elite skeleton to imbue his weapon
description.value: The caster emulates the dark energy from an elite skeleton to imbue his weapon. The caster must have a slashing weapon to use this spell. The next time this weapon strikes a creature, it discharges the dark elemental energy. The spell deals an additional 1d6 points of shadow damage against the target of the attack. In addition, the target of this attack must make a Fortitude save or suffer 1d4 Strength damage. The weapon loses this property if its wielder drops it or otherwise loses contact with it. Learned From Skeleton Family
